title: Kicked Spicy Southern Thai Mozzarella Larb
description: A spicy and molten Thai dish featuring mozzarella, perfect for a hangover cure, made with robata-grill and paleo-friendly ingredients in a larb form.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the ground chicken, fish sauce, lime juice, and salt.
Add the minced garlic and bruised lemon grass to the bowl and mix well.
Grill the chicken mixture on the robata-grill for 5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, grill the sliced mozzarella cheese on the robata-grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until melted and slightly charred.
Chop the grilled chicken into small pieces and add to a bowl with the chopped mint leaves and Thai bird eye chilies.
Add the grilled mozzarella cheese to the bowl and toss everything together.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the top of the larb and serve immediately.
